svg.title: Stellar photometry in isotop
svg.desc: Memory to magnitude, the point-spread profile of stars of different magnitude, and the nova, fade and supernova light curves.
svg.text: Memory as starlight: magnitude, point spread and flashes
A: memory to magnitude; B: halo profile; C: nova and fade; D: supernova (implemented, used by no shipped view)
The flash is -6 magnitudes for the first 0.5 s (a flux 250 times the star's own), then the star is gone and only the shell remains; the nova's -4 is a flux of 40.
